notes.title: Let's celebrate World Animal Day with Animal Week! 🥳
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello Goodkid! 👋[/b][/h3]

[h2]We are excited to announce that our game is a part of [b]Animal Week on Steam, starting today until October 10, 2024! 😻[/b][/h2] 

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/GamesIncubator/sale/AnimalWeek


This special event is organized to celebrate [b]World Animal Day[/b] and aims to raise awareness about animal welfare and conservation. During [b]Animal Week[/b], our game will be featured alongside a diverse selection of animal-themed games, offering players unique experiences that highlight the beauty and importance of the animals and environment worldwide.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/f83343576ec1afb3d85bb5b88d6719a6cd67dc4a.png[/img]

We are proud to support efforts to protect wildlife and their habitats by participating in this event. This initiative promises to provide an educational and entertaining experience for all players. 🤝

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/eb19fe493d76b11305b4420230767da78aeeadac.png[/img]

[url=https://www.wwf.pl/pomagam/adopcje/tygrys?utm_source=STEAM&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=steam+WWF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/e7160665a65210e6cdcc6e8bb638baef925e3d4a.png[/img][/url]

The [b]main partner of Animal Week[/b] is [b]WWF Poland[/b], a leading conservation organization, that brings their [b]extensive expertise in wildlife protection and environmental sustainability.[/b] Their involvement in this event underscores the shared commitment of both organizations to foster a deeper understanding of animal conservation issues among the gaming community.

[h3][b]Read more about helping the TIGER 🐯 click the banner below 👇[/b][/h3]
[url=https://www.wwf.pl/pomagam/adopcje/tygrys?utm_source=STEAM&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=steam+WWF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/0f02d1c40abac7b658288ca99db9557afc693ce7.png[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Think globally act locally 🌍[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Let’s make a difference together through the power of gaming! 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♂️[/b][/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/91f3a34156d093b6bf3cf365dcaa294e9aff9a56.png[/img]

Have Fun!!
Glory Jam

notes.title: Mending the Past. Umm, we mean a patch update for Hello Goodboy 😊
notes.content:
Hello goodkid, have you enjoyed your journey with Coco in Kuruto?

First of all, we want to thank you for playing, streaming, giving love, and giving feedback to Hello Goodboy 🙂 It’s all precious to us and we are delighted. Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/7ce256cc7b984cbbd936b026182513d813520dd3.gif[/img]

Also from all of that, we’re deploying a small update for Hello Goodboy. Mostly it's a micro bug in the graphical aspect. But we also updating a few dialogues for Hachi and Hedera in the Spring Door.

This dialogue revision will not change the story, so no need to worry much about it. We just make a few dialogues to be more generic and can be accepted by more people. If you have played the Spring Door before, can you find the changes on this patch? Tell us your finding and opinion below 😀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/2385af3252782ba59fa61097f1b6f24b0edd6bce.gif[/img]

By the way, we want to thank you too for giving review and feedback on the Hello Goodboy Steam Store page. If you haven’t, feel free to write your experience of playing Hello Goodboy there too! We love to read your review and story of your journey in Kuruto!

Feel free to share your journey in Hello Goodboy too on your social media! You can find us on [url=https://twitter.com/rollinggloryjam]Twitter[/url], [url=https://discord.com/invite/sbMcVNvD8y]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/rollinggloryjam/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://facebook.com/rollinggloryjam]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@rollinggloryjam]TikTok[/url]!

notes.title: Spring and other Seasons! November Update
notes.content:
Hello good friends! 

We’re here with a development update!

We have finished “Spring” Story Arc! Here’s a sneak peek:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/f641af29fa75def9d2b88c79baf4869ee0a2731a.gif[/img]

This means all of the season arcs are in the game - Summer, Fall, Winter, and Spring!

Much like other season arcs, Spring has its own unique in-game elements: puzzles, food, and story just to name a few. One of them is repairing the picnic bench. Can you imagine having a picnic in Spring?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/416edd260c7fb4ec58ea46a2e5778cf7e20b9b83.gif[/img]

The special iconic food in this Spring Arc is Martabak or Terang Bulan. Some people call it Martabak, but others call it Terang Bulan. Let us know in the comments what you’d call it! 

While everyone debates on what to call this food, our team contemplated how to grab it 😄
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/1e908a19f1a4d32e0922e57c56ef0127ce9c42af.png[/img]

In the meantime, our team is revisiting, polishing, and adjusting elements that already exist in the game so you, as players, will have the best experience. Some of the adjustments we’ve made are Iko and Coco’s expressions in game. By making them more expressive, we hope you will have a more immersive experience!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/2f8daacabb27fae5ab4c7a3f63720ee8b1032a20.png[/img]

We’ve begun localization and Steam Deck support as well. We’re super excited to bring Hello Goodboy to other languages and platforms!

For further updates, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sbMcVNvD8y]Discord[/url], follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/rollinggloryjam]Twitter[/url], and catch up with us on our other social medias. We’d love to hear from you!

Until next time. Be good! 🐾

notes.title: Publisher Announcement and Dev Updates!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are proud to announce that Hello Goodboy is now being published by Freedom Games ( https://freedom.gg ). For those of you who may not know, a game publisher can take care of a lot of the business and marketing side of releasing a game. That includes managing our store pages, marketing and advertising the game, helping showcase the game at both digital and live events, PR, and a lot more. Really it lets us totally focus on working to make the game the best it can be, and provides us with the resources to do so. 

Speaking of working to make the game the best it can be, we're going to start doing dev updates here on Steam to give you all a glimpse into how things are progressing 😃

Previously, we'd only created the summer story arc, but we've now added in the autumn story arc. Here's a look at the world in the beautiful autumn season. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/e724ad49a71aa193547a6512516ff0674df6af2a.gif[/img]

After this only we'll be adding in the other 2 seasons as well! 

With the new season added into the game, we'd like to introduce you to 2 new characters, Ozzela the Lumberjack and the Lazy Beaver. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/fb8ed7cdc616cb900282055e227263bcdf778fcf.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/e1180640b548fb77abef741086a88ac491729161.gif[/img]

Thank you all for your support so far throughout development, especially for those of you who have been with us since our previous titles 🙏🏻We couldn’t have gotten here without you all. We have lots more exciting things coming in the future so make sure to wishlist the game here on Steam, and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/rollinggloryjam]Twitter[/url]
